BEST Asean food we had in FOUR South East Asean countries!
Nov 2018 • Couples
My wife and I took a trip to South Asia for 35 days. A long way from Brazil. Besides Vietnam, we have been to Thailand (including beaches and islands), Cambodia and Myanmar. We tried all kinds of food, from fancy resort restaurants to a variety of street food.

Magnolia was our BEST food experience by a long shot.

The staff is very supportive, they would go out of their way to help us in all kinds of occasions. The first time we went there (by the suggestion of the front desk hotel staff), we suddenly found ourselves late for our afternoon tour due to bad scheduling. We asked them to haste as much as possible, and we thought of swallowing the food and leaving. We also had no idea of what Vietnamese food was like, so we just took the suggestions of the server. When our dishes came though... They were superb. Even having to eat fast, it tasted just so good we could not stop remarking it every time. We decided to go back there with more time.

The following day, we went there and asked details of the dishes we would order (in spite of everyone’s English, ours included, and the natural difficulty of food names translation). Also I had pictures I had taken the day before of dishes served to other guests, the presentation of which had made an impression on me. I usually don’t care much about food presentation, but they do it in beautifully, to the point of calling my attention. Once again, food was superb.

Food presentation often comes with high prices, which is just not the case. Magnolias have dishes for very reasonable prices, in spite of the beautiful presentation and wonderful food taste.

On our last day of our stay in Saigon, we lost our credit card. We thought we had forgotten it at Magnolia, but we passed by and they said it wasn’t there, after searching everything. When we got back to our hotel room, we found out the credit card had been there all day long. We went to the front desk of the hotel and asked the receptionist to call the restaurant saying we had found the card, and also to say, in good Vietnamese, they had the best food we had tried in all Asia thus far.

We had then about 15 days travelling. After all the 35 days, we still hold the same opinion. I do hope someone of the restaurant reads this.

If you are going to Saigon and plans to visit Bui Vien Walking Street, please do yourself a favor. Take Đường Đề Thám down, cross Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and keep walking a few meters. It is just the next block down on the left, less than 10 minutes from Bui Vien.

Then ask for the crunchy rice. You won’t regret it. I certainly won’t forget!

First class meal
Oct 2018
It was starting to rain and we needed to find somewhere to eat before we got soaked.
We found the Magnolia Kitchen & Cafe, it looked nice so we went in.
What a find. Nicely appointed, friendly staff and a huge menu
So much to choose from it was difficult to make a decision
I decided on the Magnolia's special fried rice. What a great choice I made.
Beautifully prepared in a large clay pot. Brought to the table piping hot.
It contained rice, of course, 4 beautiful fairly large shrimp and some small bits of pork.
All mixed together in a delicious rice with many different seasonings, such as bean sprouts, coriander and other nice spices. It was delicious. There was too much food for one to eat, such a shame. The price was extremely reasonable 110VND. 

This restaurant is out of the mainstream of downtown Ho Chi Minh, it is near the Chez Mimosa Hotel. If you are in the area, be sure and sample the fine food. You won't be disappointed. Oh, yes and thank goodness it started to rain we could sample the fine food.
